entities.summary: Inga Nielsen was a Danish soprano who had an active international opera career from 1971 to 2006. A child prodigy, Nielsen performed on American radio during the 1950s, beginning at the age of six, and also released some commercial recordings of Danish folk songs and Christmas carols as a child. She began her opera career performing parts in the lyric soprano repertory and then became an admired singer of dramatic soprano roles, beginning in the late 1980s. She was a particularly renowned interpreter of the roles of Konstanze in Mozart's Die Entführung aus dem Serail and the title role in Strauss's Salome.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Inga Nielsen's career spanned over three decades and featured notable performances in Mozart's Die Entführung aus dem Serail and Strauss's Salome. Her work contributed to the development of opera as an art form, particularly in Denmark.
